name: Tomato & Basil Pesto Baguette Pizzas with Black Olive "Spiders"

instructions.primary_message: Using a serrated or bread knife, cut the baguette crosswise into 6 portions. Holding the knife parallel to the cutting board, cut each portion in half horizontally, separating it into 2 pieces, top and bottom. (You should have 12 pieces total.)
Arrange baguette pieces on a large baking sheet pan, cut-side facing up.
To assemble the pizzas, spread pizza sauce over half of the baguette pieces and basil pesto over the other half of the pieces. Sprinkle with cheese, Italian seasoning, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (397 g) jar pizza sauce
½ cup basil pesto
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
½ tsp Italian seasoning
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place pizzas in the oven and bake for 5 minutes, until the cheese just starts to melt down and set. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, count out 24 olives, one olive for each spider (reserve remaining olives for another use). Cut olives in half lengthwise. Set 24 halves aside (these will be the spider bodies); cut the remaining 24 olive halves lengthwise into 6 thin strips (these will be the legs).
Top the pizzas with olives, arranging them in the design of a spider. (You will need 1 olive half plus 6 olive legs per spider.)
Return pizzas to the oven and continue to bake until the baguette is crispy and cheese is melted, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Transfer pizzas to a serving platter and enjoy warm!
